name: fusion
description: Adds “Fusion (multi model)” to the chat model picker. Each task is routed across Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus and run as a single call, a cascade with a quality gate, or a draft–critique–revise workflow.
author: Kyle Saunders

enumDescriptions: Prefer speed and cost: cheaper drafters, fewer reviews.
Frontier-level quality at the lowest expected cost (default).
Prefer quality: stronger drafters and more review.
fusion.objective.markdownDescription: Objective for **Fusion (multi model)** and for the gateway's `fusion` model id. **Fusion Fast** and **Fusion Quality** always use their own objective.

fusion.models.fast.markdownDescription: Model for the fast tier. An Anthropic model id, or `vscode:<vendor>/<id>` for a model another VS Code extension provides (pick one with **Fusion: Choose Models for Each Tier**).

fusion.models.frontier.markdownDescription: Model for the frontier tier (e.g. `claude-opus-5-5` or `claude-fable-5-1`).

fusion.models.critic.markdownDescription: Preferred reviewer for the critique pattern. A model from a different family (for example one provided by another extension) gives the most independent review. Empty uses the policy's choice.

enumDescriptions: A fast model classifies each new task (difficulty, signals, risk).
Route with keyword and shape heuristics only (no extra call).

fusion.forcePattern.description: Force one workflow for every task. Useful for comparing workflows; leave on auto otherwise.

fusion.gate.threshold.description: Minimum judge confidence for a cascade draft to be accepted without escalation.

fusion.cascade.maxDraftSteps.description: A cascade drafter that has not finished after this many tool-calling steps hands the task to the stronger model.

fusion.budget.maxTaskUsd.description: Per-task ceiling (USD) for optional legs: gate checks, reviews and escalations are skipped once a task has cost this much. Solver calls are never cut off.

fusion.showSummary.description: Append a one-line summary (workflow, calls, estimated cost) to each final answer.

fusion.progressUpdates.description: Show the model's short progress notes between tool calls (Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 return them as thinking summaries).

fusion.refusalFallback.description: Opt Fusion's Opus and Sonnet calls into server-side refusal fallback, so a safety-classifier false positive is retried on another model instead of failing.

fusion.maxInputTokens.description: Context window Fusion reports to VS Code. Larger windows delay history summarization but cost more per step (Haiku 5.5 is billed at a higher rate above 100K prompt tokens).

fusion.showVariants.description: Also offer Fusion Fast and Fusion Quality in the model picker.

fusion.gateway.autoStart.description: Start the Anthropic-compatible gateway (used by Claude Code) when VS Code starts.

fusion.gateway.port.description: Port for the gateway. It only listens on 127.0.0.1.

fusion.anthropic.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Advanced: alternative upstream for Anthropic API calls. Empty uses `https://api.anthropic.com`.
